description: List campaigns for ONE ad platform across all 16 ad platforms. `platform` is required -- this tool does not aggregate across platforms. Returns campaign name, status, budget, and performance metrics. 100% Free to Read ($0.00 / 0 credits — works out-of-the-box with zero configuration or API key; live write execution starts on the $20/month Solo plan).

limit.description: Maximum number of campaigns to return (default: 50)

platform.description: Ad platform to list campaigns for (required)

name: list_campaigns
